title: Branching on string comparisons
description: You can read strcmp results by their sign rather than a particular nonzero value.

steps.description: pairs holds seven string pairs, including equal strings, different cases and empty strings. You compute the row count from the array sizes.
Each iteration compares the two strings in one row with strcmp. You print the pair before describing its result.

steps.question: Which branch handles the pair containing two empty strings?
steps.answer: The equality branch handles it because strcmp returns zero for equal strings.

steps.description: You see equality, less-than and greater-than messages for the supplied cases. The recording places lowercase apple after Apple and places a nonempty apple after the empty string.
